verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs say users can extend the out-of-the-box metrics with custom LLM-as-a-judge metrics. A dedicated cookbook covers creating custom LLM-as-a-Judge metrics, and natural-language feedback can tune metrics to a domain. Experiments then score outputs against metrics of your choice, and the free plan lists unlimited custom evals. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of what can be configured (judge model selection, prompt and rubric, scoring scale), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
